label: copy-phase input a (fed-back early-position a, recall_idx 2-5)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and almost only when the input is the letter a (99.9% of activation mass), i.e. when the model has just copied back an a. It is strongest when that a was original token 1-3 (recall_idx 3, then 4, then 2). The top activations are a at original position 2, often followed by c or w. It never fires in the original phase, at the delimiter, or on the first copy step, and it is nearly silent on fed-back a at recall_idx 1 or at 6 or later. Only about half of the copy-phase a steps at recall_idx 2-5 are active, and no condition I tested (repeat count, previous token, letter vs digit output, L) separated active from inactive ones. So the precision of about 0.49 is unexplained.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: a, c, o, w, f, z; least: j, t, i, k) and the token being output (most: c, 0, w, z, a, e; least: h, u, -, p); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4, L=3 & t=4.
